summary: Reconcile signed Fabric identity rotations with bounded overlap; older Fabric blocks rekey without blocking unrelated policy changes

schema.detail: Reuses fleet.member-endpoints claims; Fabric expiry writes change durable runtime state.

compatibility.detail: The control-socket daemon version must support expiry before overlap is installed. Older daemons report rekey_blocked: fabric_without_expiry; failed probes report fabric_capability_unknown with the diagnostic. Ordinary expiry-free policy changes continue in both cases.

manual.detail: Hard deploy order: upgrade Fabric to v0.9.4 on every participating member before any rekey, then deploy Fractal with R1-R7.

recovery.detail: After the first expiry write, no in-place Fabric v0.9.3 rollback is safe without an explicit state migration. Elapsed preparation cannot renew staging or replay an obsolete transaction.
